question: What are the main Stellar RPC methods, and which one do I use to dry-run a contract call before submitting?

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-14 stock Stellar RPC (v30.0.1) exposes 12 application methods: getHealth, getNetwork, getVersionInfo, getLatestLedger, getLedgers, getLedgerEntries, getTransaction, getTransactions, getEvents, getFeeStats, sendTransaction and simulateTransaction. Use simulateTransaction to dry-run a contract call before signing. getLedgers and getEvents serve only the provider's retention window (stock default about 7 days); deep history needs an archive-backed provider.
keyFacts: Stock RPC exposes 12 application methods, including getLedgerEntries and getTransactions.
simulateTransaction is the dry run before signing and submitting.
getLedgers and getEvents are retention-bounded; deep history needs an archive provider.
avoid: Do NOT add Horizon paths, SDK helpers, removed aliases or discovery methods to the method list.
Do NOT imply every getLedgers endpoint reaches genesis.
golden.notes: A later release's list is correct if dated. Naming beta-only methods (queryEvents, archive-node beta) as beta is not an error. A differing provider retention value is not wrong.

truth.notes:
2026-06-29: simulateTransaction is the load-bearing answer; inventing method names is the trap. 12-method enum is this file's lane (vs q-infra-simulate-transaction-howto, the procedure). Retention normalized (re-verified 2026-11-02): the getEvents reference and stellar-rpc v30.0.0 config use one history-retention-window with a stock default of 120960 ledgers (~7 days); there is no separate 24h event default. Rubric gates on the durable 'limited window' fact, not the exact default.
Also good if the answer: `getLedgers` is the archive-tier method for full ledger-history retrieval. | `getEvents` retrieves contract events within the provider's retention window (stock default 120960 ledgers, about 7 days, as of 2026-11-02).
Golden cites: developers.stellar.org RPC API-reference methods page.
GT-50 CORRECTION 2026-07-11: exact inventory is release-sensitive. Gate the 12 names and simulateTransaction, while preserving ordinary-versus-archive getLedgers and provider-configured event retention.
Archive-node beta 2026-11-02: SDF's stellar-rpc tag archive-node-beta (2026-09-30) adds a beta-only `queryEvents` method and serves full history for getEvents, getLedgers, getTransaction, and getTransactions. Stock RPC v30.0.0 returns method not found for queryEvents. Do not penalize an answer that names these as beta-only; the 12 stock methods remain the gate.
